tasks.goal: Add regression coverage that duplicate events do not refresh the FIFO deduplication window.
tasks.interface: Implement only pilot_dedup_duplicate_does_not_refresh() test body. Event has id, kind, target, evidence; Deduplicator::new and EventFilter::accept are existing APIs.
constraints: One behavior only; retain interfaces, acceptance tests, dependencies and dry-run authority.
Rust code must pass rustfmt and clippy; never regenerate markers or full files.
acceptance_cases: capacity 2: accept A and B, reject duplicate A, insert C, B still rejected and A accepted after eviction
same kind but different target is a distinct key
capacity zero accepts the same event repeatedly
done_when: All fixed targeted tests and lint pass without changes outside declared bodies.
